Microneedling, also known as collagen induction therapy, is a minimally invasive cosmetic procedure that uses fine needles to create micro-injuries in the skin. These micro-injuries stimulate the body’s natural healing process, boosting collagen and elastin production. The result? Improved skin texture, reduced fine lines and wrinkles, and diminished scars and hyperpigmentation.

blocks.text: What to Expect During Your Microneedling Session ?

blocks.html: Before your session, it’s important to avoid sun exposure and discontinue the use of any retinoids or exfoliating products. Our team will provide detailed pre-treatment instructions to ensure optimal results.

During your microneedling session, a topical numbing cream will be applied to minimize discomfort. The procedure typically takes about 30 to 60 minutes, depending on the treatment area. Our skilled aestheticians will use a microneedling device to gently glide over your skin, creating controlled micro-injuries.

After the treatment, you may experience some redness and mild swelling, similar to a sunburn. This is normal and should subside within a few days. We recommend avoiding strenuous activities, direct sun exposure, and using gentle skincare products during the recovery period.
